questions.question_en: A reservoir receives transferred water from another basin. Which fact remains a separate question?
questions.question_te: Transferred water పొందే reservoirలో వేరుగా చూడాల్సిన fact ఏది?
options: Assume the transferred source becomes the local river name
The colour of the textbook cover
The river across which the reservoir structure is built
option_explanations: Transfers do not automatically rename rivers.
Cover colour is irrelevant.
Source of inflow and structural river location can differ.
Project capacities vary and require sources.
